Metadata.title: Maintenance
Metadata.description: Machine breakdown reporting and handling for the production plant

Home.title: Every breakdown has an owner, from report to sign-off.
Home.lead: The area leader reports the problem, the manager assigns a technician, the technician records the work done, and the leader confirms the machine is running.
Home.lifecycleNote: The leader can reject a repair. The ticket then goes back to the technician.

area_leader.name: Area leader
area_leader.summary: Reports breakdowns on their line and confirms the fix.

technician.name: Maintenance technician
technician.summary: Takes tickets, fixes breakdowns and records the work done.

manager.name: Maintenance manager
manager.summary: Assigns work, sets priorities and manages the team.
